question: Can I work part time here?
reply:

*   **Restricted Industries**: You cannot work in industries listed as "manufacturing" or "construction" if the employer's Business Registration Certificate lists these businesses [E1]. *   **Work Hours**: The number of allowed hours depends on your status and Korean language proficiency. Generally, it is 20 hours per week for undergraduate students (or 30 hours for masters/doctoral), but drops to 10 hours if you do not meet the Korean language proficiency standard [E2].
*   **Permit Duration**: You are permitted to work up to 1 year within your student period of stay, limited to 2 locations [E1]. If your employment location changes due to a change in employer, you must obtain a new part-time work permit in advance [E1].
*   **Prohibited Jobs**: Jobs requiring professional skills (e.g., Marketing, Translation/Interpretation) are NOT permitted under a student visa [E3].
